records.text: An anonymous surgeon commenter said the trajectory described in the medical examiner's report was not possible from the roof and would require an upward path from the neck entry point to affect the cervical spine through C2.
records.speaker: Anonymous surgeon commenter (Ep iB-YtO3UZOg)

appearances.snippet: Um, the, I'm going to read one more of these comments actually from, from doctors that were writing on YouTube. One writes, I am a surgeon based on the medical examiner's report, the trajectory from the roof is not possible. Charlie was hit in the low neck. The medical examiner's report said much of his cervical spine was dramatically gone and that the left side of C2 to C7 was obliterated. To have affected up to C2, it would have had... ... to have been an upward trajectory from the point of entry on his neck.

verification.notes: The commenter is anonymous, the claimed surgeon credential cannot be authenticated, and the medical-examiner report being interpreted is not provided in a form that can be independently reviewed. Current hearing evidence attributes the shot to the roof, but a complete wound-track record is needed to evaluate the commenter's anatomical trajectory claim. It remains unverifiable.
